release_reason: bundle is a SYNTHETIC fixture → forced ui_prototype, value_status demo. Per-region release check on non-overlapping evaluation regions ['BGD', 'AUS-NSW', 'USA-CA'] (whole-country AUS / USA and the BGD divisions are reported separately, not gated); validated_calibration needs the selected model to beat B0_identity AND B0_month_ratio on test AOI-month MAE and 80% interval coverage within ±0.10 of 0.80 in EVERY region; the overall stage is the weakest region. Regions: BGD: ui_prototype (synthetic; would be observed_comparison) (test AOI-month MAE selected=13.89 vs B0_identity=68.32 / B0_month_ratio=13.89; coverage 0.73 on n=22; is B0_month_ratio itself (cannot beat itself)) | AUS-NSW: ui_prototype (synthetic; would be observed_comparison) (test AOI-month MAE selected=13.39 vs B0_identity=53.50 / B0_month_ratio=13.39; coverage 0.91 on n=22; is B0_month_ratio itself (cannot beat itself) and interval coverage outside 0.80±0.10) | USA-CA: ui_prototype (synthetic; would be observed_comparison) (test AOI-month MAE selected=13.72 vs B0_identity=60.86 / B0_month_ratio=13.72; coverage 0.77 on n=22; is B0_month_ratio itself (cannot beat itself)). no candidate beat the baseline B0_month_ratio (val AOI-month MAE 13.195) by ≥10% without >10% active-subgroup degradation → the baseline itself is the app estimate | the selected model is B0_month_ratio itself, so 'beats B0_identity and B0_month_ratio on test AOI-month MAE' cannot hold by construction in any region → at most observed_comparison | each region has at most 12 months × 2 test years = 24 AOI-months (n is given per region), so its interval coverage has a standard error of about 0.08: coarse evidence

gate.rule: candidate replaces baseline only if val AOI-month MAE ≤ (1−0.1)×baseline and active-subgroup (aqua_count>0) cell-month MAE ≤ (1+0.1)×baseline; among passing candidates the lowest val AOI-month MAE wins
gate.gate_pool: AOI-months of the non-overlapping gated regions BGD, AUS-NSW, USA-CA (whole-country AUS / USA and BGD divisions excluded: nested, would be double-counted)
gate.baseline_rule: better (lower val AOI-month MAE) of B1_poisson and B0_month_ratio (contract v1.1)
gate.selection_reason: no candidate beat the baseline B0_month_ratio (val AOI-month MAE 13.195) by ≥10% without >10% active-subgroup degradation → the baseline itself is the app estimate

release.rule: per region on non-overlapping evaluation regions ['BGD', 'AUS-NSW', 'USA-CA']: validated_calibration needs the selected model to beat B0_identity AND B0_month_ratio on test AOI-month MAE and 80% interval coverage within ±0.1 of 0.8 in that region; the overall release_stage is the weakest gated region; observed_comparison otherwise; ui_prototype for synthetic data

aoi_notes: BD-H (Mymensingh) is absent from this Natural Earth file; its cells fall into whichever NE polygon contains them (NE's pre-2015 Dhaka division contains Mymensingh)
Bangladesh: 126 cells assigned to the nearest division (≤0.1°), 132 cells unassigned to any admin-1 (offshore / outside NE)
notes: Q1/Q2 are evaluated on bounded subsets (matched-budget comparison) and are not selection candidates for the app estimate (v1.1).

cells/<aoi>/<year>.json rows kept if aqua>0 or viirs>0 or est≥est_min (default 1.0; raised per AOI-year if > 15.0 MB, see cells_export); cell grids skipped for ['AUS', 'USA']; cell rows use complete months only.
static_source_detections_modis = Aqua MODIS type≠0 detections; static_source_detections_viirs = S-NPP VIIRS type≠0 detections (null before 2012 / when missing).

Partial months (S-NPP from 2012-01-20, Aqua from 2002-07-03, last month of a current-year file, months with NRT rows) are extract_status=partial: observed counts shown but excluded from training, baselines and anomalies.
Years that Notebook A marked missing (e.g. FIRMS 2025 yearly country files: 404) stay on the calendar as unavailable (null, extract_status missing), never zero.

Release stage is decided per region on non-overlapping evaluation regions (see release); the all-AOI pooled AOI-month metric ('all') double-counts nested AOIs and is descriptive only; the gate uses the 'gate_units' subgroup.
Absolute local paths are replaced by placeholders (<input>, <work>, <run>, <home>, <local-path>, <kaggle-path>) in every exported file.
Anomaly flags: |z(log1p)|≥1 vs same calendar month in other years (2003+), retrospective.
